description: Show an existing product on the linked account's SmartSite as a tile visitors can buy from. Pass the templateId returned by swop_create_product (or the id from swop_list_my_products). Each call ADDS a new tile and never replaces existing ones, so check swop_get_my_smartsite first to avoid duplicates; remove a tile with swop_remove_link. The product must belong to the linked account.
